noWarn.description:
List of warnings to ignore.

- Default: `[]`.

modelRoot.description:
Path to the root directory containing all model tmd files loaded by the generator (except the domains file, which is loaded separately). If omitted, the directory containing the configuration file is used.

- Default: directory containing the configuration file.

modelFilePaths.description:
When set, TopModel loads only model files matching the listed glob patterns (relative to `modelRoot`).

- Default: `["**/*.tmd"]`.

language.description: Language of technical labels written in generated content. This setting is independent of the `i18n` section (which controls localization of business labels) and the console message language (which always matches the OS language).

pluralizeTableNames.description:
Uses pluralized class names to generate SQL table names.

- Default: `false`.

defaultAssociationUseClass.description:
Sets the default `useClass` value for association properties in the model.

- Default: `false`.

rootPath.description:
Path template for incoming translation directories. Must contain the `{lang}` token.

- Default: `{lang}`.
- Templating: `{lang}`.

defaultLang.description:
Default application language. Leave empty if the application has only one unnamed language. A null value disables the default language and the use of labels defined in the model in a default language.

- Default: `""`.

langs.description:
Application languages other than the default language, identified by code.

- Default: `[]`.

translateReferences.description:
Whether reference list labels must be translated.

- Default: `true`.

translateProperties.description:
Whether property labels must be translated.

- Default: `true`.

allowPropertyLabelFallback.description:
When a property label is not set, allows its name to be used as the label.

- Default: `true`.

generators.description:
Paths to C# projects containing custom generators.

- Default: `[]`.

ignoredFiles.description:
Files to ignore after the first generation (relative to the configuration file).

- Default: `[]`.

path.description: Path of the file to ignore, relative to the configuration file.

items.description: File category the generator must read.

referencedTags.description: Tags from other configurations whose classes may be referenced in code generated by this module's generators.

additionalProperties.description: Name of the configuration from which to retrieve the tag.

oneOf.description:
Configuration languages, applied in order to select the corresponding domain, decorator, and converter implementation.

- Default: `java`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

Configuration languages, applied in order to select the corresponding domain, decorator, and converter implementation.

- Default: `java`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

tagVariables.description: Per-tag configuration variables that can be used in configuration properties that support them.

rootModule.description:

- Default: `{module:head}`.
- Templating: `{module}`.

ignoreDefaultValues.description:

- Default: `false`.

translateReferences.description:

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

translateProperties.description:
Whether property labels must be translated in this configuration.

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

disable.description: Generators to disable for this configuration.

Generation mode for values of properties with a uniqueness key.

- Default: `enum-or-const`.

oneOf.description:

API generation mode (`Client` or `Server`).

metaModel.description:
Option to generate the JPA metamodel.

- Default: `false`.

entitiesPath.description:
Persistent model class location, relative to the generation directory.

- Default: `javagen:{app:path}/entities/{module:path}`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

enumsPath.description:
Model enum location, relative to the generation directory.

- Default: `javagen:{app:path}/enums/{module:path}`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

daosPath.description:
DAO location, relative to the generation directory.

- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

dtosPath.description:
Non-persistent model class location, relative to the generation directory.

- Default: `javagen:{app:path}/dtos/{module:path}`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

apiPath.description:
Generated API location (client or server), relative to the generation directory.

- Default: `javagen:{app:path}/api/{module:path}`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

openApiAnnotations.description:
Whether `swagger-annotation-jakarta` annotations must be added to interfaces.

- Default: `false`.

oneOf.description:
Client API generation mode.

- Default: `RestClient`.

Client API generation mode.

- Default: `RestClient`.

resourcesPath.description:
Resource location, relative to the generation directory.

- Templating: `{module}`, `{lang}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

dbSchema.description:
Name of the schema where entities are stored.

- Default: `public`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

compositionConverterCanonicalName.description:
Fully qualified name of the class that converts compositions stored as JSON in the database.

- Default: `{package}.{class}Converter`.
- Templating: `{package}`, `{class}`.

associationAdders.description:
Option to generate add methods for multi-valued associations. These methods keep added objects synchronized by updating the inverse relationship.

- Default: `false`.

associationRemovers.description:
Option to generate remove methods for multi-valued associations. These methods keep removed objects synchronized by updating the inverse relationship.

- Default: `false`.

generatedHint.description:
Option to generate the `@Generated("TopModel : https://github.com/klee-contrib/topmodel")` annotation.

- Default: `true`.

fieldsEnum.description: Option to generate an enum of fields for persistent or non-persistent classes.

fieldsEnumInterface.description:
Specifies the interface of generated field enums.

- Templating: `<>`.

dataFlowsPath.description:
Location of generated data flows.

- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

dataFlowsWriter.description:
Writer to use for data flows.

- Default: `jpa`.

useJdbc.description:
Generates entities in JDBC mode instead of JPA mode.

- Default: `false`.

daosAbstract.description:
Generates DAOs as `Abstract` interfaces annotated with `@NoRepositoryBean`, to be inherited in the project.

- Default: `false`.

daosName.description:
DAO name template.

- Default: `{class}DAO` when `daosAbstract` is disabled, otherwise `Abstract{class}DAO`.
- Templating: `{class}`.

cascadeTypes.description:
Cascade types to add to generated associations.

- Default: `{"oneToOne":["all"],"oneToMany":["all"]}`.

oneToOne.description: Cascade types applied to one-to-one associations.

oneToMany.description: Cascade types applied to one-to-many associations.

manyToOne.description: Cascade types applied to many-to-one associations.

apisName.description:
Generated API class names.

- Default: depends on the API generation mode.
- Templating: `{module}`, `{fileName}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

daosInterface.description: Specifies the interface of generated DAOs.

useRecords.description:
Whether non-persistent `regular` classes with `readonly: true` must be generated as Java records.

- Default: `false`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

dataFlowsBulkSize.description:
Size of chunks to extract and insert.

- Default: `100000`.

dataFlowsListeners.description:
Listeners to add to all data flows.

- Default: `[]`.

items.description: Listener to add to all data flows

mapperTagsOverrides.description:
If a mapper contains at least one class with one of these tags, it is generated with that class's tags instead of using the default priority (persisted class tags, then mapper-defining class tags).

- Default: `[]`.

- Default: `{app}.{module}.Models`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

referencesModelPath.description:
Reference class location, relative to the generation directory. If omitted, these classes are generated like other classes, according to whether they are persistent.

- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.
- Default: `persistentModelPath` or `nonPersistentModelPath`, depending on whether the class is persistent.

nonPersistentModelPath.description:
Non-persistent model location, relative to the generation directory.

- Default: `{app}.{module}.Models/Dto`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

apiRootPath.description:

- Default: `{app}.Web`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

apiFilePath.description:
Path where generated endpoint files are created, relative to the API root.

- Default: `{module:path}`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

dbContextPath.description:
DbContext location, relative to the generation directory.

- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

dbContextName.description:
DbContext name.

- Default: `{app}DbContext`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

noBaseDbContext.description: Does not set the `DbContext` base class on the generated DbContext, allowing you to specify your own base class (with its constructor) in a partial class.

dataFlowsPath.description:
Location of generated data flows.

- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

referenceAccessorsInterfacePath.description:
Path where reference accessor interfaces are generated.

- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

referenceAccessorsImplementationPath.description:
Path where reference accessor implementations are generated.

- Default: `{dbContextPath}/Reference`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

referenceAccessorsName.description:
Reference accessor name (prefixed with `I` for the interface and then `Db` for persisted accessors). The `{module}` variable always has the `flat` transform appended.

- Default: `{module}ReferenceAccessors`.
- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

mappersName.description:
Mapper name. The `{module}` variable always has the `flat` transform appended.

- Default: `{module}Mappers`.
- Templating: `{module}`.

useEFMigrations.description:
Uses EF migrations to create or update the database.

- Default: `true`.

dbSchema.description:
Database schema name to target. If omitted, EF uses the provider's default schema (`dbo` for SQL Server, `public` for PostgreSQL).

- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

kinetix.description:
Kinetix artifacts to generate: `references` for reference list annotations and accessors, `legacy` to also generate domain annotations, and `none` to generate nothing.

- Default: `references`.

domainNamespace.description:
Namespace of the domain enum for Kinetix (legacy mode).

- Default: `{app}.Common`.

valueTypes.description: C# types the generator must treat as value types (in addition to standard types such as `int`, `bool`, or `DateTime`), which must be wrapped in `Nullable` (with `?`) to make them nullable.

nullableEnable.description: Accounts for `nullable: enable` in generated code (adding `?` after nullable reference types).

oneOf.description:
Generates non-nullable types for required properties.

- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

noColumnOnAlias.description:
Does not generate column attributes on aliases in non-persistent classes.

- Default: `true`.

oneOf.description:

- Default: `[]`.

mapperLocationPriority.description:
Class type (`persisted` or `non-persisted`) given priority when determining generated mapper locations.

- Default: `persisted`.

useEFComments.description: Annotates EF-generated tables and columns with model comments (requires `useEFMigrations`).

usePostgresEnums.description: Uses PostgreSQL enums for `enum: true` classes in the database.

dotnetVersion.description:
Specifies the target .NET version so the generator can determine which features are available.

- Default: `10`.

useRecords.description:
Uses mutable records instead of classes for class generation.

- Default: `true`.

useCancellationTokens.description:
Adds a CancellationToken parameter to generated endpoints (client and server).

- Default: `false`.

useAsyncReferenceAccessors.description:
Generates asynchronous reference accessors (for Kinetix 10+).

- Default: `false`.

resourcesResxPath.description:
Path for generated `*.resx` resource files containing translations of property and reference list labels.

- Templating: `{module}`, `{lang}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

resourcesInResx.description:
Specifies the resources to generate in resx files (when `resourcesResxPath` is set) instead of generating them in the database.

- Default: `all`.

enumCols.description: Generates column-name enums in persistent classes. Enabled automatically when `dbContextPath` is `null` and `kinetix` is set.

entityTypesPath.description: Path (or alias starting with `@`) to entity type imports, relative to the generation directory.

generateComments.description: Adds comments to generated JS entities.

generateMainResourceFiles.description: Generates an `index.ts` file that imports and re-exports all generated resource files by language. Only compatible with `resourceMode: js`.
